title: Proinsulin regulators identified with CRISPR screen and in vivo mouse QTL mapping
model: MIN6 mouse beta cells, mouse GeCKOv2 A+B knockout library, sorted on intracellular proinsulin/insulin
contrast: Proinsulin-high vs proinsulin-low sort (1 vs 1, no replicates; screening-level)
paper_method: Per-guide binomial test (FDR < 0.01), genes with at least two significant guides
barcs_calls: 356 genes at FDR 0.10 (422 against the control null; 151 with guides of at least 100 reads); screening-level, no replicate sorts
named_hits: 7/7 at FDR 0.10 (Pcsk1 #1, Cpe #2, Furin #3, Yipf5 #8, Pdia6 #13, Hid1 #17, Madd #21); 63 of the paper's 84 calls pass
verdict: BARCS reproduces the paper's proinsulin regulators (Pcsk1, Cpe, Furin, Pdia6, Yipf5 all top-15; 63 of 84 calls at FDR 0.10), drops paper hits resting on low-count guides such as Rpl7, and adds consistent multi-guide genes such as Rbm18 and Sec24c.
